svg.text: SDD Project Model v2.2 - Document Timeline by Sprint Phase

g.text: Sprint 0 (Tier 1): BRD, PRD, EARS, BDD, ADR
Complete before Sprint 1 • GATE-01 validation required
Sprint 1 (Tier 2): SYS, REQ, CTR, SPEC, TSPEC, TASKS
Specification phase • GATE-05 + GATE-09 validation required
Sprint N (Tier 3): Code, Tests, Release, CHG (if needed)
Implementation phase • GATE-12 validation + drift check
• New Feature: Full Tier 1 → Tier 2 → Tier 3
